reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives form a dual system: one rooted in historical rushing efficiency (EPA-TD scatter) and another in real-time defensive pressure (PRWR). The ARBY matchup rating bridges these by isolating line-created yardage from RB performance. Each operator exhibits distinct failure modes—EPA-TD may misrepresent outlier performances, PRWR assumes consistent edge-rusher quality, and ARBY may underweight situational factors. These operators are embedded in a Bayesian framework where uncertainty is propagated through conformal prediction layers. The dual nature of EPA-TD and PRWR reflects opposing forces in football: offensive creation and defensive resistance. The ARBY kernel introduces a third dimension—matchup-specific line performance—which allows for dynamic state transitions in GSE reasoning engines. The system's robustness depends on empirical calibration of weights and thresholds across regimes.
